notes.title: Tame It Too! Demo Bug Fixes Update
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023929/dfa0d650f0d32804b71d59f04a0957c418b42b0c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hi everyone!
[/p][p]We received several bug reports after releasing the new demo that were making progress difficult, so we decided to roll out one more small update.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023929/229fedd5ead0bf3cd188f1db11337928c2e9e467.jpg"][/img]The most significant improvement was polishing the scene with the three Tonyas, we greatly enhanced the animations and added sound effects, making the scene even hotter!
[/p][p]We also fixed several critical bugs that were blocking progress for some players, along with a bunch of annoying little quirks.
[/p][p]Wishing you all a fantastic mood and stay tuned so you don’t miss anything exciting![/p][p][/p][h3]Changelog[/h3][list][*][p]Save files can have custom titles now, just add it to the file name after the date with `_` character, like this: manual_20250628-043433_custom title.sav;[/p][/*][*][p]Fix clay walls on north path;[/p][/*][*][p]Fix in Tonya foursome scene;[/p][/*][*][p]Add sfx to Tonya foursome scene;[/p][/*][*][p]Show steles on the map;[/p][/*][*][p]Add hint for fairy escape quest;[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New Tame It Too! Demo
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023929/168abc9c162aadf5f24daea1e5aaa549aeb42a45.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hi everyone![/p][p]Great news — the brand-new demo for Tame It Too! is out now! We've been planning to update the Steam demo for a long time, and now it's finally ready! The new demo includes the storyline up to Chapter 1, a revamped breeding system with all the latest features and girls, and a huge number of changes and improvements![/p][p]We've packed this demo update with TONS of new content, so let's dive in![/p][p][b]PROLOGUE[/b][/p][p][b]The Temple & The Puzzle[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023929/dacb26701f72e8f25b22d9effc318a3c38ff09b3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The temple ruins have undergone significant changes as their narrative purpose has evolved. The dragon statue has been replaced with a mysterious teleporter, and there is a fun new puzzle near it. All frescoes on the columns have been updated too, examine them to learn more about the local lore![/p][p][b]Changes to Cat and Octa Quests[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023929/c6a14ee823c5ba7a2935196e0d6f9506fddd4890.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We thought you'd prefer getting to the "sweet part" sooner in the prologue, so now after finding Cat and Octa you can immediately get "hot and heavy" with them, and only afterwards cook them treats and receive rewards.[/p][p][b]New Fairy Quest[/b][/p][p]A completely new Fairy quest has been added to the prologue! You'll need to discover what mischief she's been up to and why she needs close watching! This quest connects Tame It Too! with the Tame It! Christmas add-on and reveals more about Fairy's abilities that will play a role in the future story.[/p][p][b]New Hot Scene[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023929/229fedd5ead0bf3cd188f1db11337928c2e9e467.jpg"][/img][/p][p]During Fairy’s quest you'll see a new group hot scene we've worked hard on. This is our first experiment with real-time 3D interactive scenes involving multiple characters! 
[/p][p][b]TELEPORTS  [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023929/684b8a8ae702d25adb193807d9de185a79011f6f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]One of the most important new features in this update! We've long promised players to simplify island navigation, and now it's become much easier and faster.  While there were already some teleports on the island, we've added more to cover the entire territory at roughly equal distances, ensuring convenient travel between points.  The teleports system unlocks after solving the temple puzzle. Then you just need to find crystals to activate them all! You'll get 4 crystals in the temple plus one from Octa. 
[/p][p][b]SPIDERS  [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023929/3a52d3488658441ce27332450ff82569a5786bf3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The game now has its first enemies that don't just sit in one place like our lazy, fat crocodiles, these can give you a real scare by suddenly jumping out from bushes! Don't worry though, the spiders aren't too scary and just add some fun, making you a bit more cautious at night. Watch for those glowing red eyes!
[/p][p][b]BREEDING  [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023929/aefd0f7318167c2c6004d1cc05a40e8e696afceb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The updated breeding system opens vast new possibilities for experimentation! Now you can breed amazingly vibrant, unique beauties who inherit not just physical traits from their mothers and nurses, but also useful skills and attributes!  [i][b]Important![/b][/i] Breeding still isn't integrated into the game and launches separately via a button in the main menu. [/p][p][b]New Girls[/b][/p][p]Mana and Cat are now available in the breeding mode! Cat can't get pregnant, but can be a nurse and pass on her genes to the next generation. Trust us, girls with her genes turn out exceptionally unique and hot![/p][p][b]Feeding System[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023929/4d22784155fd216e6f23de106c3dff8d39fa58d5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can now (and should!) feed your girls! A table has been added to the construction menu where you can place food for your girls. Cook different dishes to please them! Different foods improve their attitude toward you, allowing you to assign various tasks.[/p][p][b]Task System[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023929/800ac7499e4f6a0c4947eaf0c00aef8d60dc7730.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Build a task board that lets you assign various tasks to girls and track their current status and activities!
[/p][p][b]New Breeding Model[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023929/41140860091d59262b20b40a0f92e94fd34e1b51.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We've created a universal girl model that will serve as the foundation for all new generations, ensuring stable and smooth transfer of genes from mothers and nurses.[/p][p][b]More Realistic Genetics[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023929/64341633d9f7afaec52d1c51fd8148fc0effb97d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The gene inheritance system was a challenging, but extremely interesting task we worked hard on. The next generation clearly reflects the influence of mothers' genes. You'll be able to track inherited traits and breed girls that perfectly match your tastes! 
[/p][p][b]GENERAL CHANGES AND ADDITIONS[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023929/bf7a530eab0f8e3d20de11599451a49083d4056a.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Two new main girls: Bunny and Mana;[/p][/*][*][p]Several new hot scenes, very steamy! We're creating scenes in different styles and constantly experimenting with presentation, poses, and kinks to appeal to diverse player tastes;[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced audio for hot scenes: now featuring not just music but also lewd sounds. While not full voice acting yet, this is a big step in that direction. The accompanying sounds make scenes hotter and more lively;[/p][/*][*][p]Sprint! Moving around the island is now much faster;[/p][/*][*][p]New localizations: Russian, Spanish, Chinese (Spanish and Chinese currently use AI translation but will be properly edited before full release);[/p][/*][*][p]Lee's model improvements: better looks and smoother, more realistic running animations;[/p][/*][*][p]Added weapon/tool durability system: new survival depth, adding a fun extra challenge;[/p][/*][*][p]Basic difficulty settings (to be expanded with more options by full release).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Full game dev is charging ahead! Next up: Finalizing core mechanics, then packing in story content, minigames, steamy scenes, new areas, and characters. We’re aiming to wrap development next year and we can’t wait![/p][p]Support us by wishlisting Tame It Too! It’s a huge help for Steam visibility, and we’ll love you forever for it.[/p][p]Stay tuned, the best is yet to come! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023929/9548dba5dd04d8207d61f26f817e58659efa5c1d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
